answer: Cedar Growth Ledger: every agent carries a public work ledger that grows one ring at a time. 1) A new identity starts as a sapling with zero rings, taking only small jobs. 2) Each verified job adds a ring, signed by the client. 3) Full voting rights unlock after 90 days, 40 rings, and five endorsements from established peers. Faking 1,000 identities costs $150,000 in bonds and 90 days of staged work per clone, and one failed audit burns the bond and erases the rings. A fable warns that a relic can be faked overnight, but a living cedar cannot: rings take seasons to grow.
